list.name: sensor
list.label: Sensor
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

schema.tagValues(
  bucket: v.defaultBucket,
  tag: "sensor",
  predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "wtvb01",
  start: -30d,
)
list.definition: Sensors with actual wtvb01 data in the last 30 days

panels.description: Instantaneous three-axis acceleration from the WTVB01 normal-mode registers.
panels.title: Acceleration

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "wtvb01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["sensor"] =~ /^${sensor:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /^acc_[xyz]_g$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.sensor + " · " + (if r._field == "acc_x_g" then "X" else if r._field == "acc_y_g" then "Y" else "Z")}))
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["series"], valueColumn: "_value")

targets.query:

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_time")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.sensor + " · " + strings.toUpper(v: strings.substring(v: r._field, start: 6, end: 7)) + " · Peak " + strings.substring(v: r._field, start: 4, end: 5) + (if strings.hasSuffix(v: r._field, suffix: "_g") then " · amplitude" else "")}))
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])
  |> sort(columns: ["series", "_time"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["series"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.description: Acceleration RMS per frequency band, axis X, stacked. Shows where the energy moves: 2–10 Hz unbalance/looseness at low speed, 50–100 Hz and above bearings and gears.
panels.title: Band RMS (FFT) · X

  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])
  |> sort(columns: ["series", "_time"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["series"], valueColumn: "_value")
